mapper.select: SELECT mark_id, story_id, branch_id, user_id, last_read_time, create_time FROM zhw_mark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND story_id = #{storyId} AND branch_id = #{branchId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.mark_id, m.story_id, m.branch_id, m.user_id, m.last_read_time, m.create_time, s.title AS story_title, s.cover AS cover, /* 如果标记的是故事本身(branch_id=0)，作者是故事创建者；否则是分支作者 */ IF(m.branch_id = 0, su.nick_name, bu.nick_name) AS target_author_nick_name, IF(m.branch_id = 0, su.avatar, bu.avatar) AS target_author_avatar, /* 内容摘要：故事标记取设定内容前50字，分支标记取分支内容前50字 */ IF(m.branch_id = 0, LEFT(s.setting_content, 50), LEFT(b.content, 50)) AS target_content_preview, /* 章节名：标记故事本身时不显示章节名 */ IF(m.branch_id = 0, NULL, CONCAT('第', b.chapter_num, '章 ', IFNULL(b.chapter_title, ''))) AS chapter_name, /* 是否有新内容：分支的last_read_time之后有新子分支 */ IF(m.branch_id = 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM zhw_branch nb WHERE nb.story_id = m.story_id AND nb.del_flag = '0' AND nb.create_time > IFNULL(m.last_read_time, '1970-01-01')), (SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM zhw_branch nb WHERE nb.parent_id = m.branch_id AND nb.del_flag = '0' AND nb.create_time > IFNULL(m.last_read_time, '1970-01-01')) ) AS has_update FROM zhw_mark m LEFT JOIN zhw_story s ON s.story_id = m.story_id LEFT JOIN zhw_user su ON su.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN zhw_branch b ON b.branch_id = m.branch_id LEFT JOIN zhw_user bu ON bu.user_id = b.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zhw_mark (story_id, branch_id, user_id, last_read_time, create_time) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{branchId}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zhw_mark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND story_id = #{storyId} AND branch_id = #{branchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE zhw_mark SET last_read_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND story_id = #{storyId} AND branch_id = #{branchId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_mark WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND branch_id = #{branchId}
